input: Source a local tailor to alter my vintage blazer

gold.taskTitle: Source a local tailor to alter vintage blazer
gold.taskDescription: Find and hire a local tailor capable of altering a vintage blazer to the user's specifications.

questions.title: What city or neighbourhood should the tailor be in?
questions.description: Understand the user's location or preferred area to narrow the search to genuinely local options.

questions.title: What specific alterations does the blazer need?
questions.description: Identify the exact work required, such as taking in the waist, shortening sleeves, or replacing lining.

questions.title: What is the fabric or era of the vintage blazer?
questions.description: Determine the material and age of the blazer so a tailor with relevant expertise can be targeted.

questions.title: Do you have a budget limit for the alterations?
questions.description: Establish a maximum spend so unsuitable tailors can be filtered out early.

questions.title: When do you need the blazer returned by?
questions.description: Clarify the deadline or desired turnaround time to ensure the chosen tailor can meet it.

questions.title: Do you prefer a tailor recommended by someone you trust?
questions.description: Find out whether the user wants word-of-mouth referrals versus searching directories or review platforms.

questions.title: Is preserving the blazer's original character a priority?
questions.description: Determine how important it is to maintain vintage details, stitching style, or original hardware during alterations.
